themes.title: Academic Research
themes.description: Conduct and discuss academic research in Spanish. Learn to describe research methods, write thesis statements, use citations and references, and participate in academic discourse. This theme equips you with the formal language needed for university-level writing and presentations in Spanish.

themes.title: Advanced Argumentation
themes.description: Structure complex arguments with advanced rhetorical devices and persuasive language.

themes.title: Cultural Criticism
themes.description: Critique and analyze cultural phenomena in Spanish — art, film, music, literature, and social practices. Learn the language of aesthetic judgment, cultural commentary, and critical thinking. This theme equips you to express informed opinions about the cultural products and practices of the Spanish-speaking world.

themes.title: Economic Analysis
themes.description: Analyze and discuss economic phenomena in Spanish. Learn to describe economic theories, interpret market data, make financial forecasts, and debate economic policies. This theme equips you with the formal language needed for economics discussions in professional and academic settings.

themes.title: Literary Analysis
themes.description: Read and discuss literary texts in Spanish. Learn literary analysis terminology, interpret meaning and authorial intent, identify genres and narrative techniques, and express informed opinions about literature. This theme equips you to engage with novels, short stories, poetry, and theater in Spanish.

themes.title: Media Literacy
themes.description: Analyze and critically evaluate media content in Spanish — news, social media, advertising, and digital communication. Learn to detect fake news, evaluate sources, understand media bias, and navigate the digital information landscape with ethical awareness. This theme equips you to be an informed, critical consumer of media in Spanish.

themes.title: Political Discourse
themes.description: Navigate political analysis, policy debate, and international relations in Spanish. Learn the language of governance, diplomacy, and civic participation. This theme equips you to discuss political systems, evaluate policies, and engage with international affairs in Spanish.

themes.title: Professional Negotiation (Part 1)
themes.description: Learn negotiation vocabulary and strategies for professional settings.

themes.title: Professional Negotiation (Part 2)
themes.description: Advanced negotiation scenarios: conflict resolution, compromise, and deal-making.

themes.title: Scientific Communication
themes.description: Communicate scientific concepts in Spanish. Learn to describe research processes, present data findings, write about scientific topics, and discuss research with precision. This theme covers the language of science from laboratory to publication.

themes.title: Social Commentary
themes.description: Discuss and critique social issues in Spanish. Learn vocabulary related to inequality, justice, human rights, and activism. Develop the ability to express opinions on social topics, analyze causes and effects, and propose solutions. This theme equips you to engage thoughtfully with current social debates.
